78778.subject: Tokenized Stocks Traded $1 Billion With The Market Shut
78778.body:
**gm, Defiers!**

These are the biggest stories in DeFi and crypto:

* **[Tokenized stocks](https://thedefiant.io/news/tradfi-and-fintech/tokenized-stocks-traded-1-billion-while-the-stock-market-was-shut)**[ traded $1 billion while U.S. exchanges were shut](https://thedefiant.io/news/tradfi-and-fintech/tokenized-stocks-traded-1-billion-while-the-stock-market-was-shut)

* **[Robinhood](https://thedefiant.io/news/tradfi-and-fintech/robinhood-takes-stakes-in-crypto-com-and-og-com-as-it-routes-football-contracts)**[ took equity stakes in Crypto.com and OG.com](https://thedefiant.io/news/tradfi-and-fintech/robinhood-takes-stakes-in-crypto-com-and-og-com-as-it-routes-football-contracts)

* **[Polkadot](https://thedefiant.io/news/markets/polkadot-leads-rotation-old-layer-1s-hike-odds-widen-sep-8-2026)**[ rose 16.7% on a vote for a protocol-owned stablecoin](https://thedefiant.io/news/markets/polkadot-leads-rotation-old-layer-1s-hike-odds-widen-sep-8-2026)

* **[Compound](https://thedefiant.io/news/defi/compound-institutional-market-launch)**[ opened a lending market only institutions can enter](https://thedefiant.io/news/defi/compound-institutional-market-launch)

* **[The Ethereum Foundation](https://thedefiant.io/news/blockchains/ethereum-foundation-sets-2029-quantum-target-and-narrows-hegot-scope)**[ set a December 2029 quantum-resistance deadline](https://thedefiant.io/news/blockchains/ethereum-foundation-sets-2029-quantum-target-and-narrows-hegot-scope)

* **[Oasis Vault](https://thedefiant.io/news/defi/oasis-vault-cryptopunk-909-giveaway-self-custody?utm_source=newsletter&utm_medium=email&utm_campaign=tokenized-stocks-traded-1-billion-with-the-market-shut)**[ is giving away CryptoPunk 909 (Partner)](https://thedefiant.io/news/defi/oasis-vault-cryptopunk-909-giveaway-self-custody?utm_source=newsletter&utm_medium=email&utm_campaign=tokenized-stocks-traded-1-billion-with-the-market-shut)

The New York Stock Exchange was closed for 89 and a half hours. Tokenized versions of its listings traded $1.41 billion.

Saturday brought $490.3 million and Sunday $516.9 million across the 42 largest tokenized equities, and [the weekend's $1.01 billion nearly matched the $1.02 billion those same tokens did on Friday with the cash market open all session](https://thedefiant.io/news/tradfi-and-fintech/tokenized-stocks-traded-1-billion-while-the-stock-market-was-shut). Labor Day added $398.3 million. Robinhood's tokens took $572.8 million of the weekend, 57% of the measured total, ahead of Binance's bStocks at $303.5 million.

Robinhood leads on turnover while holding the smallest book: $133.2 million of tokenized equities against Ondo's $860 million and xStocks' $631.2 million. The busiest instrument of the weekend was QQQB, the bStocks Nasdaq-100 token, at $180.5 million against $1.34 million of circulating value, or 65 times the token's worth changing hands in a day. Memecoin pairs are still doing the work on Robinhood Chain, where a token called AI turned over $1
